title: Warden (prince) confined to upper-left corner of map
detail: In all 8 sessions, the prince warden's movement range is severely limited: X span=203-308px (out of map width 1320), Y span=188-190px (out of map height 600). The warden never reaches beyond roughly the first 25% of the map. This means the warden provides zero combat value for enemies in the middle and right portions of the map. Screenshots confirm the warden stays near the map entrance (upper-left). Possible causes: (1) orbit radius is too small relative to map size, (2) orbit center is anchored to a fixed position instead of following enemies or being player-controlled, (3) the warden's MoveOrbit logic restricts to a small area.

suggested_fix.description: Prince warden orbit center should dynamically follow the frontmost enemy cluster or allow player repositioning. Currently it appears anchored near spawn. Either increase orbit radius significantly, or make the orbit center track the centroid of active enemies, or let autoplay reposition the warden periodically.
